escape.title: Pressure escape
escape.summary: {passer} finds {receiver} beyond the pressure. The team gains ground and secures possession.
escape.explanation: Nearest opponent: {before} m at release, {gain} m gained and {after} m of space at reception. Pressing opponents bypassed: {bypassed}. Team control confirmed after {retained} seconds.
escape.limitation: Rule-based finding from synthetic positions; this does not establish intent or that an entire pressing line was beaten.
metrics: By {time}, completed passes: {completed}/{attempts}. Successful passes advancing at least ten metres: {progressive}. Completed under pressure: {pressure_completed}/{pressure_attempts}.
compare: First period: {first_completed}/{first_attempts} passes, {first_progressive} progressive. Second period: {second_completed}/{second_attempts} passes, {second_progressive} progressive. Small synthetic sample; this does not establish tactical causality.
no_escape: No pressure escape has been confirmed for the selected team at this time under our detection rule.
notice.limit: AI hourly request limit reached. Showing calculated facts.
notice.https: The Azure endpoint must use HTTPS. Showing calculated facts.
switch.title: Switch of play
switch.summary: {passer} finds {receiver} on the opposite flank with room to receive. The team retains possession.
switch.explanation: The pass shifts play {width_m} m across the pitch between opposite wide thirds, over {distance_m} m. The receiver has {space_after_m} m to the nearest opponent. Team control is confirmed {retained_s} s later.
switch.limitation: Geometric single-pass heuristic on synthetic tracking. It does not prove intent, defensive displacement or a chance created.
overload.title: Local overload
overload.summary: {attackers} attackers face {defenders} defenders around the receiving zone. The ball stays controlled locally for {retained_s} s.
overload.explanation: At confirmation: {attackers} attackers versus {defenders} defenders within {radius_m} m of the reception point. The local advantage stays at least +{minimum_advantage} throughout {retained_s} s of sampled, controlled possession in the same phase.
overload.limitation: Local headcount includes the ball carrier and goalkeepers if inside the zone. It does not measure open passing lanes, marking, offside or effective tactical superiority; tracking samples cannot establish continuous control between samples.
